title: Mastery challenge: several access routes, one service (3.7)
hints: Which object must remain the owner of the numeric balance?
The new service translates credentials; the parent still performs operations.
Validate with the query protocol, retain a parent reference and install a route only after validation succeeds.

questions.prompt: Several credentials must expose one balance. What should creating access do?

choices.why: A second balance creates divergent histories.

choices.text: Retain access to the existing service
choices.why: Operations delegate to the same service.
A copied value cannot observe future changes.

questions.prompt: After any successful operation through a new route, what must the owner observe?

choices.why: That would indicate a separate state copy.
Withdrawals must also affect the owner.

questions.prompt: For a route connected through d other routes, how much forwarding does one operation require?

choices.why: Each layer translates a credential and delegates once.
Numeric balance does not determine forwarding depth.

questions.prompt: A new route copies balance 40. Owner deposits 5. What goes wrong?

choices.why: A copied number has no link to later updates.
Credentials do not repair separate state.

checklist.step: Keep one history and validate access without an amount operation
Show changing access count and real operation results
